name: cad-eval
title: berkelium-cad-eval
description: E-C1 K3: zero-shot Qwen3-8B (GPU 0) and Qwen3-8B + cad LoRA (GPU 1) on the same items, core scoring of both, D-033 decision

steps.name: inputs
steps.cmd: python scripts/cad_fetch_data.py && python scripts/cad_fetch_inputs.py && python scripts/cad_eval.py plan

steps.name: fetch
steps.cmd: python -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download as s; s('Qwen/Qwen3-8B', revision='b968826d9c46dd6066d109eabc6255188de91218')"

steps.name: score
steps.cmd: python scripts/cad_eval.py score --workers 4 && python scripts/cad_eval.py report
